verdict.rationale: A community source reports that Fin charges $1 per successful customer session, which points to outcome-based pricing. A public pricing page (fin.ai/pricing) exists, but the cited excerpts list only features, not prices. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the per-resolution price, evidence of spend caps or usage controls, evidence that pricing is published rather than quoted, and an independent hands-on confirmation of billing behavior.
